scope: All 25000 original 1-NN test contexts: five backbones, ten datasets, 500 test cases per cell. All outcomes including stable cases, no outcome-based selection. Annotation shared across original judges.
prompt: Approved toy-tested template unchanged; no evidence requested. No prompt change to resolve the one toy ambiguity.
input: Exact original task definition and JSON target/reference text, reference dataset label and binary reference probe prediction. Target positive-class probe probability from frozen selected_flags manifest fills the approved target-prediction field. That target probability was not displayed in the original nearest-only judge user message; it is supplied here as approved annotation context. Never invent a reference probability.
blinding: Target gold labels, outcome judge IDs/scores, correctness and flip outcomes excluded from model prompts. Ground truth and design weights retained only in private join mapping.
selection: Test set only per approved next-mechanism-study plan. This does not annotate validation cases or written rationale text. Full 10-dataset coverage includes the four-dataset toxicity analysis.
decoding: Local Qwen/Qwen3.6-27B-FP8 revision e89b16ebf1988b3d6befa7de50abc2d76f26eb09; established engine, batch16, native thinking disabled, temperature0, seed20261001, max_tokens128, unconstrained generation. First production batch retained as format preflight. No automatic regeneration.
failures: Save raw outputs before parsing. Strict two-key JSON; invalid, truncated or missing calls remain explicit. Preserve ambiguous attempted batches without repeating them.
deduplication: Deduplicate only byte-identical fully rendered prompts; retain every original case mapping. Deterministic round-robin over 50 backbone-dataset groups.
limits: Annotations describe similarity/contrast and do not establish causality or internal reasoning. Preserve uncertain labels. Future outcome analysis must respect matched thresholds, weights and repeated targets.
replication: Same complete ordered 25000 test contexts as Qwen122, identical prompt bytes, no access to other annotations. Additional judges selected by measured local classification performance; that ranking does not guarantee annotation accuracy.
